title: Teen Fails to Escape Police, Gets Busted for Underage Drinking
description:
On October 1, 2021, La Crosse police were on bike patrol for Oktoberfest when they noticed a male immediately placing his can of alcohol in his right pocket when they arrived. He falsely identified himself and then decided to make a run for it...
